<p align="center"><small><strong>Inventory:</strong> Brass key &middot; Black cat companion</small></p>


<p align="center">The three handles resist, then loosen. Outside, a borrowed voice asks what you are growing. You do not answer.</p>

<p align="center">Sun warms the pumpkins. Rain feeds the ferns. Moon catches the night in a shallow trough. Which belongs to the silver flower?</p>
